app.title: RollCall
init.title: Welcome to RollCall
init.hint:
First use: download the template, fill in student information in Excel
(the roster must include Sequence / Student ID / Name / Class),
then choose the roster file to import.
status.date_updated: Switched to {date}; today's records were reloaded.
status.reloaded: The record was reloaded. Please pick a student again.
status.imported: The existing record was imported. Please pick a student again.
status.external_change: The record file was modified externally. It will be reloaded; please pick a student again.
config.title: Roll-call settings
config.duration_hint: (enter an integer from {minimum} to {maximum}, in milliseconds)
strategy.random_count_hint: Randomly select students while balancing attendance counts from other dates; students recorded today are always skipped.
strategy.random_no_count: Random — do not balance historical counts
strategy.random_no_count_hint: Randomly select students without balancing counts from other dates; students recorded today are always skipped.
strategy.seq_no_count: Sequence — do not balance historical counts
strategy.seq_no_count_hint: Follow roster order without balancing counts from other dates; students recorded today are always skipped.
strategy.seq_count_hint: Follow roster order while balancing attendance counts from other dates; students recorded today are always skipped.
dialog.confirm_stop: Are you sure you want to stop and exit?
dialog.confirm_replace: Importing will replace the current record and create a backup first. Continue?
dialog.confirm_restore:
Replace the current record with this backup?
{name}
dialog.recovery_title: Unable to open the classroom record
dialog.roster_empty: The roster has no student records. Add students before importing.
error.storage_source_missing: The record file does not exist. You can import a roster.
error.excel.invalid_file: The record file is not a readable Excel file. Retry, restore a backup, or import another record.
error.excel.invalid_header: The record file is missing required headers{sheet}. Repair the file or restore a backup.
error.excel.ambiguous_sheets: The record contains multiple usable worksheets. Choose one explicitly.
error.excel.sheet_not_found: Worksheet {sheet} was not found in the record file.
error.excel.duplicate_field: The required field {field} appears in more than one column.
error.excel.ambiguous_date_header: The date header {header} is ambiguous; use YYYY-MM-DD.
error.excel.duplicate_date: The date {date} appears in multiple columns.
error.excel.formula_key_field: A formula was found in a key field at row {row}, column {column}.
error.excel.merged_key_field: A merged cell was found in a key field ({range}).
error.excel.invalid_sequence: The sequence value at row {row}, column {column} must be an integer.
error.excel.invalid_student_id: The student ID at row {row}, column {column} is invalid.
error.excel.empty_student_id: The student ID at row {row} is empty.
error.excel.empty_student_name: The student name at row {row} is empty.
error.excel.duplicate_student_id: Student ID {no} is duplicated at row {row}.
error.excel.student_id_precision: The student ID at row {row}, column {column} may have lost numeric precision.
error.excel.duplicate_attendance: Student ID {no} already has attendance for {date}.
error.excel.write_validation_failed: The saved record could not be validated for student {no} on {date}.
error.excel.unsupported_namelist: This roster format is not supported.
error.storage_locked: The record is already being used by another RollCall instance.
error.storage_lock_failed: Unable to create a write lock in the data directory. Check its permissions.
error.storage_conflict: The record file was modified externally. Reload it before continuing.
error.storage_backup_failed: Could not create a {kind} backup for {path}.
error.storage_source_missing: The source file {path} does not exist.
error.storage_validation_failed: The written file {path} did not pass validation.
error.config.invalid: The settings file is invalid{field}. You can continue with defaults and save repaired settings.
error.config.read_failed: The settings file could not be read. Check its permissions.
error.config.write_failed: The settings file could not be saved.
error.unknown: Operation failed ({code}). Retry or choose a recovery action.
